objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed paperless document in DHC VISION, including policies, guidelines, instructions and related document versions/properties.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Selected type of the document, such as policy, guideline, procedural instruction or work instruction.

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Level used to differentiate and structure documents.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Document property maintained to link documents to master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_application
attributes.description: Document property maintained to link documents to IT applications.

attributes.name: relevant_company
attributes.description: Document property maintained for relevant companies.

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Document property maintained for areas of validity.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Document type abbreviation included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: number_per_type
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive 4-digit number for each type included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Title component of the document name.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document and maintained for document versions.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document and indicates workflow or lifecycle state.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document using TAG technology.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reader user groups and reader authorizations.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign the author of the document.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign additional personal change rights.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reviewers for checking the document.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign releasers for releasing the document, including translation.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which validity starts after release.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period used to calculate the valid until date for each document type.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document is valid.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which archived documents are retained before physical deletion.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute for distribution by e-mail notification.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute for distribution requiring active acknowledgement.

attributes.name: original_language
attributes.description: Original language version relevant for translation.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Clients in which the document is visible in a multi-client system.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in DHC VISION.
